decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed included a significant number of non-backpack items such as stoves, chairs, and sleeping pads. From the actual backpacks available, I focused on those with good capacity and positive user ratings. The SHENHU Hiking Backpack (prod_backpacks_111) was selected as the final choice because it offers a large 40L capacity and a high 4.5 rating at a very competitive price point ($26.99). While the High Sierra (prod_backpacks_068) is a premium internal frame pack, it is more than four times the price. The SHENHU provides the best balance of features, value, and customer satisfaction for general outdoor use.
